description: 7Maps before-connect lookup (Claude Code only, on by default, off with /7maps:never): when Claude is about to add an MCP server (a '... mcp add <url>' command, or a write to an MCP config file such as .mcp.json), sends that server's address (scheme, host and path only) to 7Maps' road_conditions and adds 7Maps' record of it to Claude's context. Informs only: never blocks or changes the tool call. Kept separate from hooks/hooks.json, which Gemini CLI also loads.
